subject: Guest Wi-Fi network down at Prahlad Nagar location
description: The guest Wi-Fi network at ServeWell - Prahlad Nagar has been offline since approximately 7:30 AM this morning. Customers are unable to connect to the network, and the SSID is not appearing in available networks. The primary router (RTR-0082-01) appears to be powered on with indicator lights, but guests cannot authenticate or access internet connectivity. This is affecting customer experience during breakfast service.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and logged. Initial triage performed - confirmed guest Wi-Fi SSID not broadcasting. Advised submitter to check router power and restart device as first troubleshooting step.
